info.title: RAG as a Service API
info.description: Multi-tenant retrieval-augmented generation platform. Upload documents into collections, then ask grounded questions and get answers with citations. Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer rag_live_…`) for programmatic access, or a Clerk session for dashboard-only endpoints.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Programmatic API key. Send `Authorization: Bearer rag_live_…` (or the `X-API-Key` header). Rate-limited per key; responses carry RateLimit-* headers.

SessionAuth.description: Clerk session JWT from the dashboard SPA. Required for API-key management and analytics endpoints, which never accept an API key.

userId.description: Clerk user id — present only for `session` auth.

keyId.description: Id of the API key used — present only for `apikey` auth.

Error.description: Standard error response body used across the API.

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the caller may retry (mirrors Retry-After).

limit.description: The limit that was exceeded (requests per minute).

Collection.description: A named group of documents indexed and queried together.

chunkCount.description: Number of chunks indexed; populated when `status === "ready"`.

Document.description: Metadata for an uploaded source document.

file.description: The source file (PDF, plain text, or Markdown).

answer.example: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase [1]. After 30 days, refunds are prorated [2].
answer.description: Generated answer (markdown, with inline `[n]` citation markers).

page.description: 1-based page number for paged sources (PDF); null otherwise.

snippet.example: Annual plans are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase…

score.description: Similarity score in [0, 1] from the vector store.

cited.description: Whether the model actually cited this source.

invalidMarkers.description: Markers the model emitted that map to no retrieved chunk.

query.example: What is the refund policy for annual plans?

topK.description: Max source chunks to retrieve (server clamps to a sane range).

stream.description: `true`/omitted → Server-Sent Events stream of query events; `false` → a single JSON QueryResponse.

key.description: Full plaintext key. Never returned again.

keyPrefix.description: Leading display portion; not usable to authenticate.

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful auth with this key; null/absent if never used.

revokedAt.description: When the key was revoked; null/absent while active.

ApiKey.description: An API key (never includes key material).

rateLimitPerMinute.description: Optional per-key override; defaults to the server's configured limit.

queryText.description: Present only when STORE_RAW_QUERY_TEXT is on.

post.description:
Run the RAG pipeline over a collection: embed the question → retrieve → assemble context → generate a grounded answer with `[n]` citation markers.

**Response modes** (chosen by the `stream` field):
- `stream` omitted or `true` (default): a `text/event-stream` of Server-Sent Events. Each `data:` line is one JSON event. Order: zero or more `{"type":"delta","text":"…"}` (incremental answer text), then one `{"type":"sources", sources, usage}` (resolved citations + accounting), then `{"type":"done"}`. On failure a single `{"type":"error","message":"…"}` is emitted and the stream ends.
- `stream: false`: a single JSON `QueryResponse` `{ answer, sources, usage }` — convenient for curl and offline evaluation.

200.description: The grounded answer. `text/event-stream` when streaming (default), or a JSON QueryResponse when `stream: false`.
